result.summary: Pass 2 over rework 01c: `git diff 115a480 -- docs/design/M2PROJ-invites-projects.md` read whole (sha256 of the design in the working tree 94f42efe1e073891e6a751bb2cf3805e39c48db3804ed1f9bf8755346e936742, before and after); decisions/0138 Addition 1 and the REQ amendment of the statement file names read; nothing else in the diff weakens the design (the other hunks are F23, the closed counts in the sketch text and the LOW-defect lists). P1 fixed: G2 now names RA-5 (auth-reauth.test.js 225-290) and its CASES for POST /api/admin/invites (owner_identity, a valid N4 body) and POST /api/admin/users/:id/delete (user_delete, a throwaway user), with the same checks; RA-5 stands in the red list of B5a, where those two routes are built (N4-N6). P2 fixed: B2's red list now has RLS-2 and RLS-3 with the reason (they read the tenant tables from information_schema and need fixture rows of the three organisations), and G12 says the fixture() of rls.test.js inserts a project and a version for each of A, B and C. P3 fixed: step 9a builds the entry from the session first (orgId, actorKind, actorId, ip), copies exactly four values from the plan, checks that the plan's audit has exactly those four keys before any statement and throws TypeError for any other or missing key; TP-5 now lists orgId, actorKind, actorId, ip and a missing key, with counts unchanged and no row of another organisation; M3 is restated for both wrong forms. F23 re-run on my clone (the designer's t7.mjs): good plan committed one row, a plan with orgId, actorKind, actorId or ip throws TypeError and audit_log keeps 1 row with 0 of the other organisation, a plan without details throws TypeError. My own pipeline sketch of the first pass (t9, strict-key form) had already shown this form passes TP-1, TP-2, TP-5 and PRJ-1 and kills M1-M4. N1-N3, N6, N7 done as the rework says: RL-5 reaches the cleanup through a platform route (G11); M44 is named for INV-4 and INV-5's used-code case with the answer not_found (a code planted as used with no account behind it); ACC-1 and the UAT read the consent elements through stripDeletionTerm (shownTextFindings named); B5 and F4 are split into B5a, B5b, B5c and F4a, F4b, each with its own red list (the red lists agree with my reading: B5a turns the table-reading tests red because N4 and N6 are admin routes with a purpose, B5b the tenant-route case rule of IS-1); the 4.4 wording and the F1/F2 slip are fixed. N4 and N5 are named as accepted residuals in section 5 (two rows), section 12 (LOW defects for DOC-UPDATER) and the post-deploy record, with decisions/0138 Addition 1 as the reason. No new contradiction with the requirements, decisions or the bar: the criterion table, the replacement table (now 26 rows with RA-5 inside G2), the mutants (M3 restated, M44 restated) and the counts are unchanged and consistent.
